sourceText:
Honey-Glazed Grilled Chicken
By: Euclydes Antoni...
Published: Thursday, December 3, 2009 - 11:51pm

Ingredients




1/2 cup honey
2 tablespoons soy sauce
2 tablespoons dry white wine
2 tablespoons lemon juice
2 green onions minced
2 garlic cloves minced
1 tablespoon minced fresh ginger
1/4 teaspoon salt
1/4 teaspoon freshly-ground black pepper
6 skinned boned chicken breast halves see * Note
Green onion tops for garnish

Preparation

1 * Note: Six boneless pork chops may be substituted. 2 Stir together first 9 ingredients in a shallow dish; add chicken. Cover and chill 8 hours. 3 Remove chicken from marinade, discarding marinade. Grill, covered with grill lid, over medium-high heat (350 to 400 degrees) 6 minutes on each side or until done. Garnish, if desired. 4 This recipe yields 6 servings.
